title: Misconduct as prisoner.
bodyText:
Any person subject to this chapter who, while in the hands of the enemy in time of war:

(1) For the purpose of securing favorable treatment by the person's captors acts without proper authority in a manner contrary to law, custom, regulation, or rule to the detriment of others of whatever nationality held by the enemy as civilian or military prisoners; or

(2) While in a position of authority over persons, maltreats the person without justifiable cause,

shall be punished as directed by a court-martial.
bodyHtml:
[§124B-156]  Misconduct as prisoner.  Any person subject to this chapter who, while in the hands of the enemy in time of war:

     (1)  For the purpose of securing favorable treatment by the person's captors acts without proper authority in a manner contrary to law, custom, regulation, or rule to the detriment of others of whatever nationality held by the enemy as civilian or military prisoners; or

     (2)  While in a position of authority over persons, maltreats the person without justifiable cause,

shall be punished as directed by a court-martial. [L 2022, c 286, pt of §2]
